offering_description.value: Sells investment strategies through funds and separate accounts run by affiliated boutique managers. Serves individual investors through financial advisers and institutional clients such as pensions and foundations. Earns fees on assets it manages.

primary_products.value: mutual funds; exchange-traded funds; separately managed accounts; closed-end funds; institutional investment portfolios

primary_services.value: investment management; sub-advisory services; fund distribution support

customer_segment.value: B2B: financial advisers, broker-dealers, institutional investors, pension plans, endowments, foundations; B2C: individual investors who hold funds through advisers and platforms

end_markets.value: asset management; wealth management; retirement savings; institutional investing

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: investment management fees charged on assets under management in funds and separate accounts; service fees: fees for sub-advisory and fund administration services
revenue_model.category: commissions or management fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: pools client money into funds and portfolios, sold to individual and institutional investors; service provider: manages investment portfolios for fund sponsors and institutional clients for a fee

geography_served.value: US national: Clients across the United States, with some international institutional clients

specialization.value: related lines: affiliated boutique managers offering equity, fixed income, alternative and multi-asset strategies to shared client channels

distribution_channels.value: agents / brokers: independent financial advisers and broker-dealers that sell funds to individual investors; direct sales: institutional sales team serving pensions, foundations and consultants; partners / resellers: fund platforms and retirement plan providers that offer its funds to clients
distribution_channels.category: agents / brokers; direct sales; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: registered investment advisers and broker-dealer subsidiaries regulated by the SEC and FINRA
